title: Research: add sparse four-endpoint observability census
body:
This extends the exact observability census on PR2979's changed word from pairs and triples to all 211,876 four-class supports of rank-seven endpoints. A complete GF(3) screen finds 1,353 candidates; each is rechecked over the rationals on both pinned word orientations.

The census adds six exact readout identities beyond the triple block. Four use five input coordinates; all six span the same five-dimensional space using nine terminal registers across seven endpoint classes. This suggests a sparse multi-endpoint interface that could avoid constructing a common rank-nine register, if a real caller can consume it directly.

No downstream consumer, physical realization, complete recursive invoice, or kappa improvement is claimed. The selected kappa remains 0.001672660197076918. This is a scoped follow-up to PR2979 and the pooling boundary explicitly left open by PR3172; it does not claim the general pooling idea as novel.

Validation: `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/cross-endframe-observability`; `python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/cross-endframe-observability`.
